items.title: Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board
GPT-6 Astra on OpenRouter
items.blurb: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's flagship model for demanding end-to-end work. $10 per million input tokens, $50 per million output tokens. 1,050,000 token context window, maximum output of 128,000 tokens. Higher uptime with 2 providers.

items.title: Blume: Zero-Config Docs Framework That Turns a Markdown Folder into an AI-Ready Website
items.blurb: Blume is an open-source documentation framework that converts Markdown into a complete documentation site. Built with Astro and Vite, it requires only Node.js and a single Markdown file for setup.

items.title: Corporate America is getting hooked on open-source AI
Google AI Mode shows same products 21.6% more expensive than traditional search
items.blurb: A US and UK data study: when the same product ranks in both Google AI Mode and traditional search, the AI Mode price is about 21.6% higher.

items.title: Beyond Zero: Google Publishes Successor to BeyondCorp
items.blurb: In a recent research paper, Google introduced Beyond Zero, a “security model for the AI era” that extends Zero Trust to autonomous AI agents.

items.title: Trusting-Trust Attack against an Entire Linux Distribution (via the strip utility)
items.blurb: "Ken Thompson's trusting-trust attack, in which a compromised compiler backdoors the programs it builds and reproduces the backdoor in subsequent rebuilds of itself, is widely regarded as a threat specific to compilers.
